# Osprey

> The official website and admin-maintained wiki for the Osprey Minecraft server.

## Authoritative documentation

Use the current wiki articles for gameplay mechanics, rules, and joining information. The wiki is maintained by the Osprey admins and may be updated more often than the website's field guide. Follow the wiki when older summaries disagree; do not infer missing mechanics.

- [Osprey Wiki](https://osprey.build/wiki/): official documentation and page directory
- [Current wiki page index](https://osprey.build/wiki/llms.txt): automatically generated links to every published article
- [Full wiki text](https://osprey.build/wiki/llms-full.txt): current published article text, with canonical URLs
- [Wiki sitemap](https://osprey.build/wiki/sitemap-index.xml)

## Website

- [Home](https://osprey.build/): server introduction, connection information and announcements
- [Field guide](https://osprey.build/in-depth/): overview of custom blocks and items
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/4EnjKHUG4S): community and announcements
